voice_density.method: voice was assigned by reading each opening and byline, then cross-checked against a first-person-marker rate (I/my/me/we/our/us per 1000 words) recorded per work in this manifest. Every work labelled first-person has fp/1k >= 4.5; every work labelled third-person has either fp/1k <= 5.0 with third-person self-reference present, or 0 first-person markers. The label is the reading, not the metric.

communicated_category.which: X2 - Nature 1879 abstract of the Geological Society anniversary address, footnote reads 'communicated by the author'. He supplied it; the prose is third person; it ends with a long verbatim quotation of his own conclusion. Kept out of first-person per the task spec.
